title: Adversarially-Informed Node Criticality Identification in Power Grid Measurements
summary: Power grid state estimation relies on sensor measurements that are increasingly vulnerable to adversarial corruption in cyberphysical environments, potentially leading to significant deviations in system observations. This motivates the need to identify critical measurement nodes whose compromise results in the most severe system-level impact. However, existing node criticality methods primarily rely on structural or steady-state analyses and do not explicitly account for adversarial effects on system behavior.
